fields.name: uid
fields.label: UID de WeTravel
fields.description: Identificador usado para las analíticas de WeTravel

fields.name: packages
fields.label: Paquetes de precios
fields.description: Opciones de precio según el tipo de viajero. Ejemplo: Usuario de silla de ruedas, $3,845, depósito $500.

fields.name: itinerary
fields.label: Itinerario detallado
fields.description: Un objeto por cada día del viaje. Ejemplo: Día 1, Arribo a Lima.

fields.name: images
fields.label: Imágenes del tour
fields.description: Imágenes mostradas en la galería. Ejemplo: /images/dieciochoprincipal.webp.

fields.name: links
fields.label: Enlaces importantes
fields.description: Enlaces de reserva, folleto y consultas. El enlace de reserva puede contener el ID de WeTravel al final.

fields.name: packages
fields.label: Price packages
fields.description: Pricing options for each traveler type. Example: Wheelchair User, $3,845, deposit $500.

fields.name: name
fields.label: Package name
fields.description: Traveler category, for example Wheelchair User or Partner.

fields.name: deposit
fields.label: Deposit
fields.description: Required deposit, for example $500. Leave empty when there is no deposit.

fields.name: itinerary
fields.label: Detailed itinerary
fields.description: One object per travel day, such as Day 1: Arrival in Lima – Welcome to Peru.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Day title
fields.description: Short title, for example Arrival in Lima – Welcome to Peru.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Day description
fields.description: Detailed activities, accessibility and included assistance for the day.

fields.name: images
fields.label: Tour images
fields.description: Images displayed in the tour gallery.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Image title
fields.description: Optional title shown as image metadata.

fields.name: links
fields.label: Important links
fields.description: Booking and information links. The booking URL must include the WeTravel package ID at the end when available.

fields.name: brochure
fields.label: Brochure link
fields.description: URL or display text for the brochure.

fields.name: inquire
fields.label: Inquiry link
fields.description: URL or display text for inquiries.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
